scripts.migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec backend uv run alembic upgrade head && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec invoice-service uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend run lint && uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory invoice-service ruff check .
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest && uv run --directory invoice-service pytest
scripts.format: prettier --write "**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,mjs,js,cjs,cts}" && uv run --directory backend ruff format . && uv run --directory invoice-service ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,mjs,js,cjs,cts}" && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && uv run --directory invoice-service ruff format --check .
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend run build && uv build backend && uv build invoice-service
